compute_chamfer_distance: compute the chamfer distance between two PyTorch 3D point clouds using L2 norm
compute_single_directional_chamfer: compute the single directional chamfer distance from points in x to nearest neighbors in y
compute_chamfer_with_normals: compute the chamfer distance between two point clouds with normal vector cosine similarity loss
compute_hausdorff_distance: compute the Hausdorff distance between two point clouds by using max point reduction
compute_weighted_chamfer_distance: compute the weighted chamfer distance between two point clouds with per-batch element weights
